title: Polynomial-time decidability of prefix circuit evaluation
statement: Let $L$ consist of the bit strings that encode a pair $(C,x)$ by doubling every bit of the circuit encoding $C$, appending the separator $01$, and then appending $x$, where $C$ is a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, each gate has fan-in at most two, $n\leq |x|$, and $C$ evaluates to true on the first $n$ bits of $x$. Then $L$ is decidable in polynomial time by a finite-state multitape Turing machine.
hypotheses_covered: Circuit is a directed acyclic circuit
Each gate has fan-in at most two and satisfies the well-formedness conditions
Input string has length at least $n$
Circuit evaluates to true on the first $n$ bits of the string
Pair encoding uses the encoded circuit and the string
